messages:
maria (prod): Heads-up — we need a clear decision on routing policy priorities for Q3 roadmap. Customer asks are stacking: affinity lanes, regional guarantees, and a fallback model when capacity spikes. Can we capture tradeoffs & launch gates here?

samir (arch): +1. I sketched a KPI-driven matrix earlier. Key constraints: p95 latency target, cost delta by tenant band, and isolation complexity. Quick note: affinity lanes add ~12% infra cost but reduce cross-tenant noisy-neighbor incidents.

jules (eng): Helpful to be explicit about thresholds. Proposal:
- Canary: 2% traffic for 1 week, p95 < 200ms
- Rollback if error rate > 0.5% or latency regresses > 20%
- Cost guard: if unit-cost increases > 15% escalate to biz

anya (sales): Customers A & B are pushing for hard regional residency + SLA. They will pay for dedicated capacity but want our migration timeline. We should prioritize gating for top-5 ARR accounts.

samir (arch): Agree. Suggest we define three lanes:
1) Affinity premium (reserved, regional pinning) — for top customers
2) Soft-affinity (best-effort regional preference + KV-cache warmers) — mid-market
3) Default (global routing with cost-first fallbacks) — self-serve

maria (prod): Nice. Can we add measurable launch criteria per lane? e.g., acceptance tests, canary windows, perf budgets?

jules (eng): Draft criteria:
- Perf: p50/p95/p99 targets per lane (p95 affinity <= 180ms)
- Reliability: 99.9% availability for Affinity premium in launch region
- Ops: Playbook for evacuations, automated failover < 3m
- Cost: quantization/packing configs validated to limit delta < 12%

ops-bot: Incident runbook template created: https://go/repo/runbooks/tenant-affinity (created by ops-bot)

anya (sales): Real ask: include contractual clause about fallback behavior (we degrade to smaller model rather than fail) — legal wants exact phrasing.

samir (arch): Technical note: fallback to smaller model reduces token cost ~40% and latency by ~30% but changes output distribution. Need eval hooks and customer opt-in. We should make that an opt-in behavior for Affinity premium; default lane gets automatic fallback.

maria (prod): Ok action items:
- Samir: attach KPI matrix + rough infra cost model by EOD Wed
- Jules: prototype canary config + test harness for fallback behavior by next Tues
- Anya: list top-5 customers who require affinity and confirm contract language TODOs
- Ops: final runbook review and SLO text

maria (prod): Meeting to decide: Friday 10am. Bring hard numbers. If we hit targets, we push Affinity premium pilot in next sprint. :thumbsup:

jules (eng): noted. Will add synthetic traffic scripts and a perf dashboard widget.

samir (arch): I’ll include a short migration path and a rollback playbook. Also adding metric we can monitor in the console: "affinity_eviction_rate" and "regional_failover_time".

anya (sales): Thanks — will sync with customers and surface any additional legal constraints before Friday.

maria (prod): Thanks team — keeping this tight. Short thread, heavy impact.
